items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: He fired Hank Duncan because Hank Duncan came on the job drunk... I said, you come to work tonight... And he went in and took the charges out.

ctx.x: Yes. Except I showed him these books and all. And a mess when we went to Europe when I was crying about my brother, but he hadn't given me the correct amount. Marg sure watches that money. I said, you're damn right, that's why she's with me. And I always went to the front for him, took care of everything. He fired Hank Duncan because Hank Duncan came on the job drunk.
